gloss: next room; adjacent room; neighboring room

definitions.gloss: next room; adjacent room; neighboring room
definitions.explanation: The room immediately next to or adjacent to a given room. Used for hotel rooms, apartments, offices, hospital rooms, and other indoor spaces.

examples.japanese: {隣室|りんしつ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: I can hear music from the next room.

examples.japanese: {隣室|りんしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住人|じゅうにん}→住人：11611_juunin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うるさくて→うるさい：00763_urusai⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}れない→眠れる：15166_nemureru⟧。
examples.english: I can't sleep because the neighbor in the next room is noisy.

examples.japanese: ⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{隣室|りんしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{知|し}り{合|あ}い→知り合い：03253_shiriai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{泊|と}まっていた→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: An acquaintance was staying in the room next to mine at the hotel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{隣室|りんしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}われている→行う：01238_okonau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧にして⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: A meeting is being held in the next room, so please be quiet.

notes:
Formal compound of 隣 (adjacent, next to) + 室 (room). More concise and written-style than the everyday expression 隣⟦の→の：09472_no⟧部屋. Common in apartment/hotel complaints, mystery novels, and any context where sound travels between rooms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {隣室|りんしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{騒音|そうおん}→騒音：03315_souon⟧: noise from the next room
- {隣室|りんしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{響|ひび}く→響く：00099_hibiku⟧: to carry to the next room
- {隣室|りんしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住人|じゅうにん}→住人：11611_juunin⟧: occupant of the next room
- {隣室|りんしつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧: wall shared with the next room

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧: the next room — everyday equivalent; used in speech
- {別室|べっしつ}: separate room — a different room, not necessarily adjacent
- ⟦{奥|おく}→奥：00980_oku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧: the back room — the room further inside
